title: Supplier Rebate Missed-Claim Console
oneLiner: An ops-finance dashboard that flags earned supplier rebates at risk of going unclaimed because proof, timing, or threshold tracking is incomplete.
targetUser: Brand operators, wholesale finance managers, and ecommerce operations teams managing vendor rebate programs.
keyUX: Scan rebate dollars at risk, open one supplier program, and see threshold progress, missing proof, and the next claim action without spreadsheet hopping.
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop operations dashboard called Supplier Rebate Missed-Claim Console for brand operators and finance teams managing vendor rebate programs. It should help users recover earned rebate dollars by connecting supplier programs, purchase thresholds, proof-of-performance gaps, filing deadlines, and expected payout into one decision surface. Include a rebate dollars-at-risk KPI strip, a supplier program priority table, a threshold progress chart, a missing-proof checklist panel, a claim deadline timeline, and an action drawer with owner assignment. Design direction: use a financial analysis aesthetic with deep navy, cool gray, muted green, and restrained amber accents so the screen feels audit-friendly, cash-focused, and precise rather than flashy.
